name: Hurstville Golf Club
why: OSM numbers the holes from the old clubhouse: its 10-18 are the course's 1-9 today (and its 1-9 the 10-18). Found from his GPS app's blue card, 2026-10-21: front nine 260, 134, 132, 342, 288, 538, 112, 382, 148 against OSM 10-18's lines 264, 134, 132, 340, 286, 534, 110, 370, 151, with the same dogleg on 8; back nine 296, 117, 434, 162, 290, 376, 486, 496, 285 against OSM 1-9's 289, 116, 428, 160, 279, 372, 479, 491, 323. In play on 2026-10-21, with OSM's numbers, every hole showed a different hole. The origin never changed.
